info.name: Hermes - VNYX product verification
info.description:
Local test collection. Start with 00, then 01-06 which
need no VNYX token and no Gemini key.

Open Postman Console (Ctrl+Alt+C) to see the findings and
patches printed as a readable list for each request.

request.description:
Same numbers as 02, but retail_price provenance is 'grounded'.
Now the anchor outranks the price, so the PRICE gets recomputed
down into the Grade C band. Same bug, opposite repair.

request.description:
Fetches by id and writes safe patches back. Needs VNYX_API_TOKEN.
Keep HERMES_DRY_RUN=true until you trust the output.
Background sweep. Results land in logs/audit.jsonl, not the response.

Edit config/policy.yaml, hit this, no restart needed.
Use it to tune the grade bands while testing.
